options: Managing memory allocation overhead, avoiding lock contention, and handling edge-case failure propagation gracefully.
Forcing all requests through a single synchronized monitor lock to prevent any multithreading.
Disabling all runtime assertions and ignoring validation exceptions to maximize throughput.
Storing sensitive state in unencrypted static variables accessible across tenant boundaries.
